title: Japanese Pork Ramen
description: A savory and comforting ramen dish filled with tender pork and infused with Japanese flavors. This recipe is perfect for a cold day or a hangover remedy.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the soy sauce, zesty ginger, and sesame oil to the broth.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
While the broth is simmering, cook the Japanese ramen noodles according to the package instructions.
Slice the pork shoulder into thin strips and cook in a pan over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan with the pork and stir to combine.
Pour the hot broth over the noodles and pork, and top with chopped green onions.
